tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

specDir.description: Path to the directory containing AsyncAPI JSON spec files.

logLevel.description: Value for the RUST_LOG environment variable (for example: info, debug, trace).

listenPort.description: Port the GraphQL HTTP server listens on.

command.description: Subcommand to run: serve (default), validate, listen or print-schema.

defaultTtlSecs.description: Default TTL in seconds for cached values before they expire.

strictValidation.description: Drop schema-invalid payloads instead of caching them. (STRICT_VALIDATION)

enableOptionalSensorValues.description: Serve each stamped field independently (nullable) instead of all-or-nothing. (ENABLE_OPTIONAL_SENSOR_VALUES)

enableMutations.description: Expose the spec extension's mutations and lifecycle directives. (ENABLE_MUTATIONS)

existingSecret.description: Existing secret name containing MQTT password.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret that stores the MQTT password.

devicesTopicPrefix.description: MQTT_DEVICES_TOPIC_PREFIX for specs whose topics read it; empty leaves it unset.

controllerTopicPrefix.description: MQTT_CONTROLLER_TOPIC_PREFIX for specs whose topics read it; empty leaves it unset.

simulatorTopicPrefix.description: MQTT_SIMULATOR_TOPIC_PREFIX for specs whose topics read it; empty leaves it unset.

controlTopicSuffix.description: MQTT_CONTROL_TOPIC_SUFFIX for specs whose topics read it; empty leaves it unset.

controllerTopicSuffix.description: MQTT_CONTROLLER_TOPIC_SUFFIX for specs whose topics read it; empty leaves it unset.

simulatorTopicSuffix.description: MQTT_SIMULATOR_TOPIC_SUFFIX for specs whose topics read it; empty leaves it unset.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling images from a private registry.
